G1909.forms: ἐπί (before a smooth breathing ἐπ᾽, before a rough breathing ἐφ᾽)
G1909.strongs: properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.
G1909.kjv: about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), with
senses: prep. with genitive, dative, accusative (accusative most frequently in NT), with primary sense of superposition, on, upon.
of place, answering the question, where?

of the place on which, on, upon: ἐπὶ (τ.) γῆς, [[r:MAT.6.10|Mat 6:10, 19]], al.; τ. κεφαλῆς, [[r:1CO.11.10|1Co 11:10]]; τ. νεφελῶν, [[r:MAT.24.3|Mat 24:3]]o, al.; like ἐν, in constr. praegn. after verbs of motion: βάλλειν, [[r:MRK.4.26|Mrk 4:26]]; σπείρειν, ib. 31; ἔρχεσθαι, [[r:HEB.6.7|Heb 6:7]], al.; figuratively, ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας (MM, see word ἀ.); of the subject of thought or speech, [[r:GAL.3.16|Gal 3:16]]; of power or authority, over, πάντων, [[r:ROM.9.5|Rom 9:5:]] τ. γάζης, [[r:ACT.8.27|Act 8:27]]; ἐξουσία, [[r:REV.2.26|Rev 2:26 20:6]];

of vicinity, at, by: τ. θαλάσσης, [[r:JHN.6.9|Jhn 6:9]]; τ. ὁδοῦ, [[r:MAT.21.19|Mat 21:19]]; τοῦ βάτου, [[r:MRK.12.26|Mrk 12:26]] (see Swete, in l.); with genitive of person(s), in the presence of, before, [[r:MAT.28.14|Mat 28:14]], [[r:ACT.23.30|Act 23:30]], [[r:1CO.6.1|1Co 6:1]], al.
with genitive of person(s), in the time of: ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου, [[r:LUK.4.27|Luk 4:27]]; ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου, [[r:ACT.11.28|Act 11:28]]; ἐπὶ Ἀβιάθαρ ἀρχιερέως, when A. was high priest, [[r:MRK.2.26|Mrk 2:26]];

with genitive of thing(s), at, at the time of: [[r:MAT.1.11|Mat 1:11]], [[r:HEB.1.2|Heb 1:2]], [[r:2PE.3.3|2Pe 3:3]]; ἐπὶ τ. προσευχῶν, [[r:ROM.1.10|Rom 1:10]], [[r:EPH.1.16|Eph 1:16]], [[r:1TH.1.2|1Th 1:2]], Phm 4.
C. dative, of place, answering the question, where?

lit., on, upon: [[r:MAT.9.16|Mat 9:16, 14:8]], al.; after verbs of motion (see supr., I, 1, (a)), [[r:MAT.9.16|Mat 9:16]] [[r:ACT.8.16|Act 8:16]]; above, [[r:LUK.23.38|Luk 23:38]]; at, by, [[r:MRK.13.29|Mrk 13:29]], [[r:JHN.5.2|Jhn 5:2]], [[r:ACT.5.9|Act 5:9]], al.;

metaphorically, upon, on the ground of, [[r:LUK.4.4|Luk 4:4]] (LXX); in the matter of, [[r:MRK.6.52|Mrk 6:52]] (see Swete, in l.); upon, of, concerning, [[r:ACT.5.35|Act 5:35, 40]]; of the ground, reason or motive (Bl., §38, 2; 43, 3), [[r:MAT.18.3|Mat 18:3 19:9]], [[r:ROM.12.12|Rom 12:12]], al.; ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, for the reason that, because, [[r:ROM.5.12|Rom 5:12]] [[r:2CO.5.4|2Co 5:4]]; after verbs of motion, over, [[r:MAT.18.13|Mat 18:13]], [[r:ROM.16.19|Rom 16:19]], al.; of a condition (cl.), [[r:ROM.8.20|Rom 8:20]], [[r:1CO.9.10|1Co 9:10]]; ἐπὶ δυσὶ μάρτυσιν (see Westc. on [[r:HEB.9.10|Heb 9:10]]), [[r:HEB.10.28|Heb 10:28]]; of purpose or aim, [[r:EPH.2.10|Eph 2:10]], [[r:PHP.4.10|Php 4:10]]; of authority, over, [[r:MAT.24.47|Mat 24:47]] [[r:LUK.12.44|Luk 12:44]]; of hostility, with dative of person(s) (cl.), against, [[r:LUK.12.52|Luk 12:52]]; in addition to (cl.), [[r:2CO.7.13|2Co 7:13]]; of an adjunct, in, at, on, [[r:PHP.1.3|Php 1:3 2:17]].
of place of motion upon or over, answering the question, whither?

lit., upon, over: [[r:MAT.14.28|Mat 14:28, 29]], [[r:LUK.5.19|Luk 5:19]], al. mult.; in NT also, answering the question, where? (as with genitive, dative), [[r:MRK.4.38|Mrk 4:38 11:2]], [[r:LUK.2.25|Luk 2:25]], [[r:JHN.1.32|Jhn 1:32]]; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, [[r:ACT.1.15|Act 1:15 2:1]], al.; of motion to a vicinity, to, [[r:MRK.16.2|Mrk 16:2]], [[r:ACT.8.36|Act 8:36]], al.;

metaphorically (in wh. "the accusative is more widely prevalent than it strictly should be," Bl., §43, 1); of blessings, evils, etc., coming upon one, with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.10.13|Mat 10:13 12:28]], [[r:ACT.2.17|Act 2:17]], [[r:JHN.18.4|Jhn 18:4]], [[r:EPH.5.6|Eph 5:6]], al.; of addition (dative in cl.), λύπη ἐπὶ λύπην, [[r:PHP.2.27|Php 2:27]]; ἐπικαλεῖν ὄνομα ἐπί (see: ἐπικαλέω), [[r:ACT.15.17|Act 15:17]], [[r:JAS.2.7|Jas 2:7]]; καλεῖν ἐπί, to call after, [[r:LUK.1.59|Luk 1:59]]; of number or degree: ἐπὶ τρίς (cl. εἰς τ.), thrice, [[r:ACT.10.16|Act 10:16 11:10]]; ἐπὶ πλεῖον, the more, further, [[r:ACT.4.17|Act 4:17]] [[r:2TI.2.16|2Ti 2:16 3:9]] (see also infr., 2, (a)); ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (see infr., ib.), forasmuch as, [[r:MAT.25.40|Mat 25:40, 45]], [[r:ROM.11.13|Rom 11:13]]; of power, authority, control, [[r:LUK.1.33|Luk 1:33]], [[r:ACT.7.10|Act 7:10]] [[r:ROM.5.14|Rom 5:14]], [[r:HEB.3.6|Heb 3:6]], al.; of the direction of thoughts and feelings, unto, towards, [[r:LUK.1.17|Luk 1:17 23:28]], [[r:ACT.9.35|Act 9:35, 42]], [[r:ROM.11.22|Rom 11:22]], [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9]], [[r:EPH.2.7|Eph 2:7]], [[r:1TI.5.5|1Ti 5:5]], al.; of purpose, for, [[r:MAT.3.7|Mat 3:7]], [[r:LUK.23.48|Luk 23:48]]; ἐφ᾽ ὅ πάρει (Rec. ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, [[r:MAT.26.50|Mat 26:50]]; of hostility, against, [[r:MAT.24.7|Mat 24:7]], [[r:MRK.3.24|Mrk 3:24-26 10:11 13:8]], [[r:LUK.9.5|Luk 9:5]], [[r:JHN.13.18|Jhn 13:18]], [[r:ACT.7.54|Act 7:54]], [[r:1CO.7.36|1Co 7:36]], [[r:2CO.1.23|2Co 1:23]]; Of reference, concerning, for (cl. usually dative), [[r:MRK.9.12|Mrk 9:12 15:24]], [[r:JHN.19.24|Jhn 19:24]], [[r:ROM.4.9|Rom 4:9]].

during, for: [[r:LUK.4.25|Luk 4:25]] (WH, txt., omits ἐπί), [[r:ACT.13.31|Act 13:31 16:18]], [[r:HEB.11.30|Heb 11:30]], al.; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (χρόνον), as long as, for so long time as, [[r:MRK.9.15|Mrk 9:15]] [[r:ROM.7.1|Rom 7:1]], al. (for ἐφ᾽ ὅ in another sense, see supr., 1, (b)); ἐφ᾽ ἱκανόν (see: ἱ), [[r:ACT.20.11|Act 20:11]]; ἐπὶ πλεῖον (see supr., 1, (b)), yet longer, further, [[r:ACT.20.9|Act 20:9 24:4]];

In composition, ἐπί signifies: up, ἐπαίρω; upon, ἐπίγειος, ἐπιδημέω, ὠπικαθίζω; towards, επιβλέπω, ὠπεκτείνω; over (of superintendence), ἐπιστάτης; again, in addition, ἐπαιτέω; against, ἐπιορκέω, ἐπιβουλή. (AS)

G1937.strongs: to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully or otherwise)
senses: (θυμός), to set one's heart upon, desire, lust after, covet: absol., [[r:JAS.4.2|Jas 4:2]], [[r:ROM.7.7|Rom 7:7 13:9]]" (LXX), [[r:1CO.10.6|1Co 10:6]] (of. 4Ma.2:6); before κατά (against, in opposition to), [[r:GAL.5.17|Gal 5:17]]; prop. (as in cl.) with genitive, [[r:ACT.20.33|Act 20:33]], [[r:1TI.3.1|1Ti 3:1]]; in late Gk. also with accusative (M, Pr., 65), [[r:MAT.5.28|Mat 5:28]] (Rec. αὐτῆς; T omits; cf. [[r:EXO.20.17|Exo 20:17]], [[r:MIC.2.2|Mic 2:2]], [[r:WIS.16.3|Wis 16:3]], al.); with inf., [[r:MAT.13.17|Mat 13:17]], [[r:LUK.15.16|Luk 15:16 16:21 17:22]], [[r:1PE.1.12|1Pe 1:12]], [[r:REV.9.6|Rev 9:6]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:HEB.6.11|Heb 6:11]]; as in Hebrew, ἐπιθυμία ἐπεθύμησα, [[r:LUK.22.15|Luk 22:15.]]† SYN.: ὀρέγω (cf. Field, Notes, 204), θέλω (DCG. i, 453) (AS)

G1967.strongs: tomorrow's; but more probably from and a derivative of the present participle feminine of; for subsistence, i.e. needful
senses: (cf. περιούσιος,), found only in the phrase ἄρτος ἐ., EV, daily; R, mg., for the coming day: [[r:MAT.6.11|Mat 6:11]], [[r:LUK.11.3|Luk 11:3]]. (Several derivations find support, each pointing to a different meaning.
ἐπιοῦσα (sc. ἡμέρα) (or, ἐπὶ τὴν ἰοῦσαν (sc. ήμέραν), Zorell, see word), hence, for the morrow or for the coming day (R, mg.).
(a) ἐπί + οὐσία, hence, for subsistence, needful (Am. R, mg.);

ἐπί + εἶναι in fern. ptcp. form, hence, pertaining to (the day). For renderings of versions and views of various writers, see reff. in DB, ext., 36 f.; DCG, ii, 58 f., 62a; ICC on Lk, l.with The EV, daily, is based on the Vg. (Lk; OL, Mt, Lk, quotidianus). "It is difficult not to think that τὸν ἐ. rests upon misunderstanding of an original Aramaic phrase, or upon a Greek corruption" (ICC on Mt, l.with; cf. also Cremer, 239).† (AS)

G1934.strongs: to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand, to crave
senses: ἐπι-ζητέω, -ῶ "directive" of ζητέω (MM, Exp., xiv), to inquire for, seek after, wish for: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.6.32|Mat 6:32 12:39 16:4]], [[r:LUK.12.30|Luk 12:30]], [[r:ACT.19.39|Act 19:39]], [[r:ROM.11.7|Rom 11:7]], [[r:PHP.4.17|Php 4:17]], [[r:HEB.11.14|Heb 11:14 13:14]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.4.42|Luk 4:42]], [[r:ACT.12.19|Act 12:19]]; with inf., [[r:ACT.13.7|Act 13:7.]]† (AS)

G1929.strongs: to give over (by hand or surrender)
G1929.kjv: deliver unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer
senses: to give over, to hand: with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.7.9|Mat 7:9, 19]], [[r:LUK.11.11|Luk 11:11-12 24:30, 42]], [[r:ACT.15.30|Act 15:30]]; pass. with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.4.17|Luk 4:17.]]

G1921.strongs: to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge
senses: absol.: [[r:ACT.25.10|Act 25:10]], [[r:1CO.13.12|1Co 13:12]]; before ὅτι, [[r:LUK.1.22|Luk 1:22]]; τ. πνεύματι, before ὅτι, [[r:MRK.2.8|Mrk 2:8]];

with accusative of thing(s): [[r:LUK.1.4|Luk 1:4 5:22]], [[r:ACT.12.14|Act 12:14 27:39]], [[r:ROM.1.32|Rom 1:32]], [[r:2CO.1.13|2Co 1:13]], [[r:COL.1.6|Col 1:6]], [[r:1TI.4.3|1Ti 4:3]]; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, [[r:MRK.5.30|Mrk 5:30]]; before ὅτι, [[r:1CO.14.37|1Co 14:37]]; (with) with accusative of person(s): [[r:MAT.11.27|Mat 11:27 14:36 17:12]], [[r:MRK.6.33|Mrk 6:33]] (T, αὐτούς, but LTr., WH, R, omit the prop., and LTr., WH, txt., read ἔγνωσαν), [[r:MRK.6.54|Mrk 6:54]] [[r:LUK.24.16|Luk 24:16, 31]], [[r:1CO.16.18|1Co 16:18]], [[r:2CO.1.14|2Co 1:14]]; before ἀπό, with genitive of thing(s), [[r:MAT.7.16|Mat 7:16, 20]]; before ὅτι, [[r:ACT.3.10|Act 3:10 4:13]], [[r:2CO.13.5|2Co 13:5]]; pass., [[r:1CO.13.12|1Co 13:12]]; opposite to ἀγνοούμενοι, [[r:2CO.6.9|2Co 6:9.]]

to discover, ascertain, determine: [[r:ACT.9.30|Act 9:30]]; before ὅτι, [[r:LUK.7.37|Luk 7:37 23:7]], [[r:ACT.19.34|Act 19:34 22:29 24:11 28:1]]; with accusative of thing(s), before quæst., [[r:ACT.23.28|Act 23:28]]; δι᾽ ἣν αἰτίαν, [[r:ACT.22.24|Act 22:24]]; παρά, with genitive of person(s), before περ, with genitive of thing(s), [[r:ACT.24.8|Act 24:8]]; τ. ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης, [[r:2PE.2.21|2Pe 2:21]] (cf. Lft., Col., 136; Cremer, 159; M, Pr., 113; AR, Eph., 248 ff.).† (AS)

G1911.strongs: to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to
G1911.kjv: beat into, cast (up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on
senses: trans., to cast, lay or put upon: with accusative and dative, [[r:MRK.11.7|Mrk 11:7]], [[r:1CO.7.35|1Co 7:35]]; with accusative, before ἐπί with accusative, [[r:REV.18.10|Rev 18:10]], WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, [[r:MAT.26.50|Mat 26:50]], [[r:LUK.20.19|Luk 20:19 21:12]], [[r:JHN.7.30|Jhn 7:30]], [[r:ACT.5.18|Act 5:18 21:27]]; with dative (Polyb.), [[r:MRK.14.46|Mrk 14:46]] [[r:ACT.4.3|Act 4:3]]; with inf., [[r:ACT.12.1|Act 12:1]]; τὴν χ. ἐπ᾽ ἄροτρον, [[r:LUK.9.62|Luk 9:62]]; ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ ἱμάτιον, [[r:LUK.5.36|Luk 5:36]]; ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ, [[r:MAT.9.16|Mat 9:16.]]

to throw oneself or rush upon: τ. κύματα εἰς τ. πλοῖον, [[r:MRK.4.37|Mrk 4:37]]; metaphorically, to put one's mind upon (but see Field, Notes, 41 ff.), ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν, when he thought thereon (sc. τ. ῥήματι), he wept (EV, txt.; R, mg., he began to weep; cf. M, Pr., 131): [[r:MRK.14.72|Mrk 14:72]] (see also Swete, in l);
to fall to one's share: τὸ ἐπιβάλλον (sc. dative; Hdt., a1., a technical formula frequently in π.; Deiss., BS, 230, LAE, 152), [[r:LUK.15.12|Luk 15:12.]]† (AS)
that which is thrown over, a cover.
trans., to turn about, round or towards, hence metaphorically, to turn, cause to return (to God, virtue, etc.): [[r:LUK.1.16|Luk 1:16-17]] (cf. [[r:MAL.3.24|Mal 3:24]]), [[r:JAS.5.19|Jas 5:19-20.]]

to turn, turn oneself around: [[r:ACT.16.18|Act 16:18]]; with inf., [[r:REV.1.12|Rev 1:12]]; before πρός, [[r:ACT.9.40|Act 9:40]]; so also pass. (cl.), [[r:MRK.5.30|Mrk 5:30 8:33]], [[r:JHN.21.20|Jhn 21:20]]; metaphorically, of turning to God (see Field, Notes, 246 ff.), ἐπὶ τ. κύριον (θεόν), [[r:ACT.9.35|Act 9:35 11:21 14:15 15:19 26:20]]; πρὸς τ. θεόν, [[r:1TH.1.9|1Th 1:9]], [[r:2CO.3.16|2Co 3:16]]; ἀπὸ σκότους εἰς φῶς, [[r:ACT.26.18|Act 26:18]]; pass., [[r:1PE.2.25|1Pe 2:25]];

to return (as in MGr.): [[r:LUK.8.55|Luk 8:55]], [[r:ACT.15.36|Act 15:36]]; before ὀπίσω, with inf., [[r:MAT.24.18|Mat 24:18]]; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.12.44|Mat 12:44]], [[r:MRK.13.16|Mrk 13:16]], [[r:LUK.2.39|Luk 2:39 17:31]]; ἐπί, [[r:2PE.2.22|2Pe 2:22]]; metaphorically, before ἐπί, [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9]]; πρός, [[r:LUK.17.4|Luk 17:4]]; of moral reform, [[r:MAT.13.15|Mat 13:15]], [[r:MRK.4.12|Mrk 4:12]], [[r:LUK.22.32|Luk 22:32]], [[r:ACT.3.19|Act 3:19 28:27]]; pass., [[r:MAT.10.13|Mat 10:13]] (Cremer, 531, 881).† (AS)

G1941.strongs: to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.)
senses: to call, name, surname: with accusative (cl.), [[r:MAT.10.25|Mat 10:25]]; pass., [[r:ACT.1.23|Act 1:23 4:36 10:5, 18 10:22 11:13 12:12, 25]], [[r:HEB.11.16|Heb 11:16]]; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐπί (denoting possession, as Heb. עַל.. שֻׁם קָרָא), [[r:ACT.15.17|Act 15:17]] (LXX), [[r:JAS.2.7|Jas 2:7]] (see. CB on [[r:AMO.9.12|Amo 9:12]]).

Mid. (so also act.; cl., LXX), to call upon, invoke, appeal to (θεόν, θεούς, Hdt., Xen., al.; cf. Deiss., LAE, 426): Καίσαρα (Σεβαστόν, [[r:ACT.25.25|Act 25:25]]), [[r:ACT.25.11|Act 25:11-12, 21 26:32 28:19]]; sc. τ. Κύριον Ἰησοῦν, [[r:ACT.7.59|Act 7:59]]; μάρτυρα (cl.) τ. θεόν, [[r:2CO.1.23|2Co 1:23]]; πατέρα, [[r:1PE.1.17|1Pe 1:17]]; τ. κύριον, [[r:ROM.10.12|Rom 10:12]], [[r:2TI.2.22|2Ti 2:22]]; τ. ὄνομα κυρίου (μου, σου; like Heb. יְהוָֹה שֻׁם קָרָא), [[r:ACT.2.21|Act 2:21]] (LXX) [[r:ACT.9.14|Act 9:14, 21 22:16]], [[r:ROM.10.13|Rom 10:13-14]]" (LXX) [[r:1CO.1.2|1Co 1:2]] (Cremer, 335, 742).† (AS)

G1905.strongs: to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek
senses: to in­quire of, consult, question: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.12.34|Mrk 12:34]], [[r:LUK.2.46|Luk 2:46]], al.; with dupl. accusative, [[r:MRK.7.17|Mrk 7:17 11:29]], [[r:LUK.20.40|Luk 20:40]], al.; with accusative of person(s), before λέγων, [[r:MAT.12.18|Mat 12:18]], [[r:MRK.9.11|Mrk 9:11]]; εἰ, [[r:MRK.8.23|Mrk 8:23]], [[r:LUK.23.6|Luk 23:6]], al.; ἐ. θεόν, [[r:ROM.10.20|Rom 10:20]] (LXX).
In late Gk., to beg of, demand of: with accusative of person(s) and inf., [[r:MAT.16.1|Mat 16:1]] (cf. ἐρωτάω; and see Cromer, 716) (AS)

G1949.strongs: to seize (for help, injury, attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively)
G1949.kjv: catch, lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on)
senses: ἐπι-λαμβάνω always mid. in LXX and NT (see Cremer, 758), to lap hold of: with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.14.31|Mat 14:31]], [[r:ACT.17.19|Act 17:19 21:30, 33]]; with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), [[r:LUK.9.47|Luk 9:47 14:4 23:26]] (WH, but see Bl., 1015), [[r:ACT.9.27|Act 9:27 16:9 18:17]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:MRK.8.23|Mrk 8:23]], [[r:ACT.23.10|Act 23:10]], [[r:HEB.8.9|Heb 8:9]]" (LXX); with genitive of person(s) and of thing(s), [[r:LUK.20.20|Luk 20:20, 26]]; τ. αἰωνίου (ὄντως) ζωῆς, [[r:1TI.6.12|1Ti 6:12 6:19]]. Metaphorical (as in [[r:SIR.4.11|Sir 4:11]]), [[r:HEB.2.16|Heb 2:16]] (see Westc., in l).† (AS)

to show, exhibit, display: with accusative and dative, [[r:MAT.16.1|Mat 16:1 22:19 24:1]], [[r:LUK.17.14|Luk 17:14]]. Mid., to display for oneself or as one's own (but cf. El., § 55, 1): [[r:ACT.9.39|Act 9:39.]]
to show, point out, prove: with accusative, [[r:HEB.6.17|Heb 6:17]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.18.28|Act 18:28]] (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).† (AS)

G1950.strongs: to lose out of mind; by implication, to neglect
senses: ἐπι-λανθάνομαι (alternative mid, form of ἐπιλήθω, to cause to forget) to forget, neglect: with inf., [[r:MAT.16.5|Mat 16:5]], [[r:MRK.8.14|Mrk 8:14]]; with genitive, [[r:HEB.6.10|Heb 6:10 13:2, 16]]; with accusative (as occasionally in cl.; MM, Exp., xiv), [[r:PHP.3.13|Php 3:13]]; ὁποῖος ἦν, [[r:JAS.1.24|Jas 1:24]]; pass. ptcp. (cf. [[r:ISA.23.16|Isa 23:16]], [[r:SIR.3.14|Sir 3:14 23:14]], [[r:WIS.2.4|Wis 2:4]]), [[r:LUK.12.6|Luk 12:6]].† (AS)

G1982.strongs: to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence
senses: ἐπι-σκιάζω to throw a shadow upon, overshadow: with dative, [[r:ACT.5.15|Act 5:15]]; of a shining (Mt, l.with, and cf. [[r:EXO.40.29|Exo 40:29, 35]], [[r:2MA.2.8|2Ma 2:8]]) cloud, with dative, [[r:MRK.9.7|Mrk 9:7]]; with accusative, [[r:MAT.17.5|Mat 17:5]], [[r:LUK.9.34|Luk 9:34]]; metaphorically (cf. Pss, Pr, ll.with), of the Holy Spirit, [[r:LUK.1.35|Luk 1:35.]]† (AS)

G1910.strongs: to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive
G1910.kjv: come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take ship
